target.title: fix(audit): widen isLoopbackPublishHost to full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range
target.body:
## What

Changed `isLoopbackPublishHost` in the security audit module from exact `"127.0.0.1"` match to `normalized.startsWith("127.")`, covering the full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range.

## Why

The existing check only matched exact `127.0.0.1`, missing the full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range. Docker containers and sandbox environments commonly publish ports on other loopback addresses like `127.0.0.2`. The canonical implementation in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` uses the full loopback range via `ipaddr.js`.

## Evidence

- **audit-extra tests**: 6/6 pass (including `isLoopbackPublishHost` coverage)
- **canonical implementation**: `src/gateway/net.ts` `isLoopbackHost` delegates to `isLoopbackIpAddress` which checks the full loopback range
